pages.aboutBody:
PlantLens AI helps farmers and plant lovers identify plants, diseases, pests and care needs from a single photo.

Take a photo of the affected part of the plant, ask a question, and keep the conversation going until it's clear. Answers are generated by AI and are best used as a first guide.
pages.privacyBody:
PlantLens AI currently uses no accounts or database. Your consultation history and photos are stored only in this device’s browser.

When you send a question, the photo and conversation are sent to an AI service (OpenAI) to generate an answer. They are not stored on PlantLens AI servers.

You can delete a consultation at any time, or clear your browser data to remove everything.
pages.termsBody:
PlantLens AI answers are generated by AI and can be wrong. Use them as guidance, not as a replacement for expert advice.

When using pesticides, always follow the product label and local regulations. For serious problems or large losses, consult an agricultural extension officer.

Don't upload photos that contain other people's personal data.
pages.helpBody:
1. On the Consult page, tap Take Photo or Choose from Gallery.
2. Write a question or pick an example, then tap the send button (or press Enter on a computer).
3. Continue the conversation with follow-up questions on the chat page.
4. Every consultation is saved in History. Use the search box to find one.

Camera not showing? Allow camera access in your browser, or choose a photo from the gallery.
The answer language follows the language chosen in Profile when the consultation starts.
